description: This file defines the SharedStorage class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, which implements a plugin interface for shared storage management, including notifications and remote connection handling. It declares internal classes for notifications and manages various shared storage interfaces.

classes.name: SharedStorage
classes.description: Implements a plugin for shared storage with notification and remote connection management, exposing interfaces for storage operations, inspection, limits, and caching.

classes.name: Store2Notification
classes.description: Notification class for shared storage value changes, calls the event handler on value change.

classes.name: RemoteConnectionNotification
classes.description: Notification class for remote connection activation and deactivation events, triggers deactivation handling when a connection is lost.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the SharedStorage plugin with the provided service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.
